title: great for an AuDHD brain
body: it’s been so hard to find calendar & reminder systems that work for my AuDHD brain & this has been the best i’ve found. being able to visualize the amount of time i have scheduled for each task, & how much time there is between them, as well as being able to break down calendar items into smaller sub tasks, has been so helpful! i keep both my calendar schedule as well as personal routines & errands & to-do items all in this one app now.
author: GangeWifre

title: I wanted to love it but hard to set up
body: I have AuDHD and really really wanted to love this app.  Unfortunately I just couldn’t get it to save anything and I grew very frustrated.  Sorry!
author: wellwellelle
